scheme_name: Jawaharlal Nehru Aluminium Research & Design Centre (JNARDDC)
overview: Jawaharlal Nehru Aluminium Research & Design Centre (JNARDDC) is a premier research and development institute under the Ministry of Mines, Government of India, focused on aluminium and allied materials. It provides scientific and technical support to the aluminium industry through research, testing, design, and consultancy services. The centre aims to enhance the competitiveness of the Indian aluminium sector by promoting innovation, quality improvement, and sustainable practices. JNARDDC also offers training and skill development programmes for industry personnel and students.
objectives: Conduct research and development in aluminium and allied materials
Provide testing, evaluation, and certification services to the aluminium industry
Offer design and engineering support for aluminium products and processes
Deliver technical consultancy and solutions to industry problems
Impart training and skill development in aluminium technology
Promote energy efficiency, waste reduction, and sustainable practices in aluminium production
Support import substitution and export promotion through indigenous technology development
Collaborate with national and international institutions for technology transfer and joint research
eligibility: Industries, MSMEs, startups, research institutions, and individuals seeking technical support in aluminium and allied materials can avail of JNARDDC's services. There are no specific restrictions based on entity type or size, but services are primarily aimed at those engaged in aluminium production, processing, or application.
benefits: Access to advanced research facilities, expert technical guidance, testing and characterization services, product design and development support, process optimization consultancy, failure analysis, material selection advice, training programmes, and customized solutions to improve quality, productivity, and competitiveness in the aluminium sector.
financial_support: JNARDDC provides services on a consultancy and fee-based model; financial support in the form of grants or subsidies is not a primary feature of the centre. Users are required to pay for the services availed based on the nature and scope of the work undertaken.
application_process: 1. Identify the specific technical or research requirement related to aluminium or allied materials. 2. Contact JNARDDC via email, phone, or through the official website to discuss the requirement. 3. Submit a formal request detailing the scope of work, objectives, and expected outcomes. 4. JNARDDC evaluates the request and prepares a proposal with scope, timeline, and cost estimate. 5. Upon acceptance of the proposal and payment of advance fee (if applicable), the work is initiated. 6. Regular progress updates are provided during the execution phase. 7. Final report, test results, or deliverables are submitted upon completion. 8. Payment of balance dues, if any, is made as per the agreed terms.
required_documents: Formal request letter detailing the scope of work
Specifications of material or product to be tested/evaluated
Drawings, designs, or process details (if applicable)
Any relevant standards or reference materials
Purchase order or agreement for availing services
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year based on service availability and project scheduling.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Mines, Government of India
caveats: Services are provided on a payment basis; no free financial grants are offered
Undertaking of work is subject to technical feasibility and availability of experts/facilities
Confidentiality of client data is maintained, but clients may need to sign NDAs for sensitive projects
Timelines may vary depending on the complexity of the work and equipment availability
